subject: Small slip, nicer than expected
text:
Hi,

Just a quick update so you aren't left guessing: I've slipped a little on the flyer layout because the venue photos arrived with better lighting than expected. Turns out the club's old banners came back beautifully, so I'm resizing a few shots rather than replacing them entirely. It might be a day slower, but the end result is actually sharper than we planned. Sorry for the wait, and I'll send the proof as soon as it's tidy. No rush on feedback yet.

Cheers,
